function pendingChainUpper31() { try { echo "U|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "UPPER|", $reply, "|"; return $reply; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function pendingChainOuter31() { try { echo "O|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "OUTER|", $reply, "|"; return $reply; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
$child = pendingChainChild31(); $middle = pendingChainMiddle31(); $upper = pendingChainUpper31(); $outer = pendingChainOuter31();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); unset($child); echo "H|";
echo "S|"; $sent = $upper->send(new PendingChainArgument31()); echo "RETURN|", $sent, "|", $upper->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->key() === null ? 1 : 0, "|";
echo "N|"; $outer->next(); echo "CURRENT|", $outer->current(), "|", $outer->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
